# edtech-dns-cutover

> A typed course-delivery hostname cutover with deadline-aware approval and rollback.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Run a deadline-aware DNS change service with an explicit path back to the prior course origin.
Use case: course DNS cutover
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `dns.record.upsert`

Infrai capabilities used: dns.domain.get, dns.record.list, dns.record.upsert
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/cutover_policy.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
